name: Sham (no field)
origin: Sham arm of blinded field studies (Granqvist et al. 2005: helmet on, no field; Gendle & McGrath 2012: device unplugged) and of placebo-helmet studies with no field at all (Andersen et al. 2014; Maij & van Elk 2018; Maij, van Elk & Schjoedt 2019; Simmonds-Moore et al. 2017)
summary: No coil is driven, with the same timers and relay behaviour as a real session, for blinded comparisons. Prefer the 'Blind' option, which picks real or sham at random for any program. What is established is the sham effect: people report unusual experiences under a helmet that emits no field.
notes: What 'established' refers to: independent groups found that people report presence-type and other unusual experiences under a helmet that emits no field, in sensory deprivation and expecting an effect, and that absorption, spirituality or paranormal belief predict these reports (Granqvist 2005 sham arm; Andersen 2014; Maij & van Elk 2018; Maij, van Elk & Schjoedt 2019; Simmonds-Moore 2017). It is not a null result for any field and not an effect of this program. Not established: that the helmet adds anything to sensory deprivation alone. How many people report something depends on the instructions: 52.4 % reported no extraordinary experience in Maij & van Elk 2018 (p.9), almost half reported another being in the room in Andersen 2014 (p.14 [230]), and none of 37 reported unusual perceptual experiences in Gendle & McGrath 2012 (p.9 [225]). In Granqvist 2005 the traits predicted the exit-scale and mysticism scores, not the single sensed-presence item (p.5). The Maij and van Elk studies are not controls of a field: they have no field at all and present an inert helmet as active (Maij et al. 2019 p.4 [110], p.6 [112]). This program drives no coil for 20 min; the intensity setting has no effect. Off is not always zero: Gendle & McGrath unplugged their sound-card device because its solenoids gave 0.1-0.2 uT of hum with the program off (Gendle 2012 p.5 [221]). Whether this helmet's off output is zero with the coils connected has not been measured in the sources read. A sham only helps if you cannot tell it from the real session: keep the room, instructions and timing identical, record your ratings before unblinding, and note which arm you guessed. If you can hear coil hum in the real session, mask it in both arms. Unpleasant feelings can come from the setting alone; stop on distress.
setting: Identical to the program it is compared with.
schedule: Decide the outcome measure in advance; at least two real and two sham sessions in counterbalanced order, at least 24 h apart.
source: Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ (suggestibility, not the field, predicted experiences) ; Maij & van Elk 2018, Conscious Cogn 66:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30355534/ ; Maij, van Elk & Schjoedt 2019, Religion Brain Behav 9:108 https://doi.org/10.1080/2153599x.2017.1403952 ; Thomas et al. 2007 (silent identical sham headsets) https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2670735/
